explanation_short: The Decision Tree (DT) model shows moderate performance with an R2 score of 0.56 and an RMSE of 0.175.
explanation_full: The Decision Tree (DT) model exhibits moderate predictive performance, as indicated by its R2 score of 0.5605 and a Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) of 0.1755. When compared to other models in the table, its performance metrics suggest it is outperformed by KNN and RF. The scatter plot diagnostics further detail that the correlation between predicted and actual values is 0.787, with a linear fit slope of 0.803, indicating a positive but not extremely strong linear relationship.
